title: Eben Moglen: How I discovered Free Software and met RMS
summary: A clip in which Eben Moglen tells how he grew up when software was freer and how his path crossed Richard Stallman's. He describes how they came to work together to make software free again.
why: Cited for a short talk that frames graphical interfaces as point-and-grunt versus language-based Unix, and for showing Moglen's regard for Stallman.

quote.text: only 10 minutes long but jam packed with wisdom
